title: Terracoin wins a full-difficulty Bitcoin block, a year after "collapse"
summary: One new canonical parent at Bitcoin height 950,154 shows Terracoin still sporadically clears the full Bitcoin target, keeping its merge-mining window open.
body:
A single new canonical parent at Bitcoin height `950,154` shows Terracoin still sporadically clears the full Bitcoin target, a year after its merge-mining activity was thought to have collapsed.[^1]

Its merge-mining window therefore stays open, and the live classifier's proof-of-work target check - not a leading-zero proxy, which over-counts sub-difficulty shares - remains the authority on which candidates count.
